data.explanation:
Suitable for use with most thermal calculators, 
                    cash registers and debit machines, This Thermal Paper Rolls are 100% BPA-free to provide high-quality, crisp, dark imaging. 
                    This printing media uses lint-free premium stock to help reduces paper jams, 
                    which saves time and money. The hard plastic core keeps the paper roll uniform for smoother feeding to the printer, 
                    and is also economical as you can use the roll to the very end (unlike coreless rolls).
description: For thermal POS, cash registers and debit machines

data.explanation:
This Copy Paper delivers high-quality results time and time again. 
                    Perfect for black-and-white printing and compatible with most machines, 
                    this 75g, 92 Brightness printer paper delivers crisp text. 
                    Each case of this letter size paper contains 5000 sheets, 
                    making it a great option for high-volume offices.
description: Ideal for black-and-white printing including emails, drafts, coupons and more in both the home and office.
Ideal for use in printers, copiers and plain paper fax machines
Made of fibre from well-managed forests, located in Windsor, Quebec
Acid free so it won't yellow or crumble over time

                    reports and other documents. With a 3,000-page yield,
